name: Natsuiro Destiny
source:
Hero is asked by his grandmother to represent her as administrator of girls dormitory while she is away. He starts living with five girls under the same roof. What kind of adventures await him during this month?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受祖母委托，在她离开期间代为管理女子宿舍。他开始与五名女孩住在同一屋檐下。这个月等待他的，会是怎样的冒险？

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndreview[/url]）
